html:
Bhumibol Adulyadej was king of Thailand from 1946 to 2016, at the time the longest reigning monarch in the world. He was born in Massachusetts in the United States.

He came to the throne after his brother's sudden death and rebuilt the standing of the monarchy, which had been weakened by the 1932 revolution. He toured villages, backed thousands of royal development projects and stepped in during crises in 1973 and 1992.

Critics noted his ties with military coups and the use of strict laws against insulting the monarchy. His death in 2016 brought a year of national mourning. See Phibun and Chulalongkorn.
sum: Bhumibol Adulyadej was king of Thailand from 1946 to 2016, at the time the longest reigning monarch in the world. He was born in Massachusetts in the United States.
